svg.title: AG206 map — zoomed
svg.desc: Source room-map-140635-ag206-zoomed.png. Header and Back are editable. Map geography, labels and captured pointer artifact are raster evidence, not live or editable map objects. Prototype ArrowUp/ArrowDown represent observed AX Increment/Decrement results, not observed native keyboard input. No arbitrary pan, zoom bounds or Google Maps handoff is implemented.
